# Original connected-label fixtures

These four chemical diagrams are original Bondline test data, dual-licensed MIT OR
Apache-2.0. They are not exports from a proprietary application. Node points and literal
Element/H/bond data are explicit; independent FontTools4.61.1 BoundsPen/hmtx/GPOS
measurements of the existing Apache Roboto produce the no-p ink boxes. No font, template,
icon or image is copied here.

Font SHA256: `56a45233d29f11b4dfb86d248e921939d115778f87325e7ae8cc108383d6664d`.
The [contract](../../../../../docs/research/connected-label-styles.md) separates public
format facts from original geometry and unresolved reference-pixel behavior. Actual
Expat/Decimal and independent RDKit direct CDXML checks are recorded in the receiving
document. These files declare graph/text/style input, not expected rendered bond ends.
No rejected AABB illustration or unapproved golden is included.
